name: Radon Transform (Direct)
aliases: Kingston and Svalbe Discrete Radon Transform
definition: Computes the Radon transform (sinogram) of a batch of multi-channel images by rotating the image and summing along one axis for each angle.
summary: Radon Transform (Direct) computes sinograms by rotating images and summing along one axis in the spatial domain, unlike Fourier-space approximations.
